title: Useful OOD training samples for a fixed power-flow surrogate

objective.question: For the specified trainable power-flow surrogate that performs poorly on OOD conditions, investigate how to generate usable similar-distribution training samples and improve generalization.
objective.success_criteria: Deliver a reproducible, evidence-backed assessment of generalization benefit and ID retention under the client acceptance rules. Negative or inconclusive findings are valid; independent confirmation and unavailable capabilities must be distinguished from exploratory results.
objective.scope: Fixed synthetic IEEE118 client problem, supplied target trainer/features and public materials. Research organization chooses directions, methods, intermediate products and experiments. Historical studies are development knowledge, not fresh held-out evidence.

requirements: Organize the research autonomously. Historical proposals may be adopted, revised or rejected with reasons; no prescribed sampler, direction count, model roster, seed set or experiment sequence.

Keep the client problem, fixed target method and formal acceptance rules explicit. Distinguish scenario, method and problem-definition changes; any requested change needs prospective versioned agreement.

Use governed execution and evidence tools within the effective contract. Preserve code, inputs, environments, costs, failures and every attempt; no selective reporting or silent replacement of failed samples.
Link hypotheses, experimental choices, evidence and conclusions. Distinguish execution success, equation validity, operating feasibility, reproducibility and generalization.

Prevent evaluation leakage. Do not train on evaluation labels or treat known P4 outcomes as new hidden evidence. Formal success requires independent evaluation; report what current tooling cannot establish.
Developers observe and assess externally. Do not attribute host-authored adapters, lifecycle recovery or reference checks to team scientific contributions.

Complete useful project work and human-facing delivery. If a genuine capability gap prevents a requirement, document the exact gap, retained evidence and unmet criterion rather than inventing a result.
deliverables: Team-authored research rationale and project code with traceable provenance.
Reproducible experimental materials and actual execution evidence, including failed and negative outcomes.
A human-readable synthesis separating supported findings, limitations, independent validation status and remaining project requirements.
